title: Shopping online
instructions: Kerem neden internetten alışveriş yaptığını anlatıyor. İyi ve kötü yanlara dikkat et.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: These days, I buy almost everything online, even food.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: It's quicker than going to the shops, and I can do it at midnight if I want.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: Prices are often lower online too.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: But sometimes clothes don't fit, and sending them back is annoying.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: Last month, I ordered a jacket three times before I got the right size!

questions.feedback: Yiyecek dahil neredeyse her şeyi internetten alıyor.
questions.evidence: I buy almost everything online, even food.

questions.prompt: What is the problem with buying clothes online?
questions.feedback: Bazen kıyafetler olmuyor ve geri göndermek can sıkıcı.

questions.prompt: How many times did he order the jacket?
questions.feedback: Doğru bedeni alana kadar ceketi üç kez sipariş etti.
questions.evidence: I ordered a jacket three times
